svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: W10 Phone layouts (375 px)
General expectation: usable on a laptop and reasonably usable on a phone.
RideSync · Team 20 · low-fidelity wireframe
ANNOTATIONS
Breakpoints
1024 px and up: two columns. 768–1023 px: one
column with the sidebar. Below 768 px the
sidebar becomes a ☰ drawer and the top bar
keeps the actor and balance.
Forms
Full-width fields and a 48 px primary button.
Inputs use 16 px text so phones don't zoom,
and the fare opens a decimal keypad.
Map
The map sits on top and the results are in a
bottom sheet that can be dragged up. Polling
works the same as on desktop.
Tables become cards
Below 640 px each table row becomes a card
with the key fields. Paging stays on the
server.
Touch
Targets are at least 44 px. No information is
hover-only: chart tooltips also open on tap.
